body.x: Tech Trans will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its brakes/axel pedals, medical device cases, and glasses.

An official said, “Tech Trans aims to be the world's best company with the best technology in non-ferrous metals to produce the best customized products. We possess core technology for functional surface treatment of nonferrous metals such as magnesium and aluminum titanium. We have masters and doctors in chemistry, physics and electrical engineering, and the company holds more than 10 patents. I think we have the best metallic color and aluminum casting surface treatment technologies that are known to be technically difficult.”

He continued, “The difference between development value and other technologies pursued by the company derives the company to focus on technology development with the goal of eco-friendliness, high functionality, and cost reduction. The company attracted 7 billion won of investment and is doing its best to continuously develop technology and expand mass production facilities. The company's technology is extensive and has many potential customers from global electric and electronic parts manufacturers. Tech Trans will continue to participate in large foreign conferences such as CES to promote its technology widely and partner with potential customers.”

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
